summary.text: William Freeman is the Republican candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 88, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Billy Mitchell.

paragraphs.text: William Freeman advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary for District 88, in which he received all 1,161 votes cast.
According to Ballotpedia, he was also the Republican candidate for the same seat in 2022 and 2024, losing to Mitchell in both general elections.
Ballotpedia also lists him as the Republican candidate for Georgia State Senate District 41 in 2020, when Democrat Kim Jackson won the general election.
